added_lemmas.statement: In a quadratic-mean differentiable semiparametric model, at any fixed law where a scalar parameter is pathwise differentiable, the asymptotic variance of every regular estimator of that parameter is no smaller than the squared Hilbert-space norm of its canonical gradient.

source.locator: Sections 2--3, especially the semiparametric variance-bound characterization

attestation.note: The stable DOI and exact section locator are supplied in lieu of a verbatim source transcription; only the scalar regular-estimator variance lower bound is used.

proposed_statement_changes.proposed: In a quadratic-mean differentiable semiparametric model, at any fixed law where a scalar parameter is pathwise differentiable, the asymptotic variance of every regular estimator of that parameter is no smaller than the squared Hilbert-space norm of its canonical gradient.
proposed_statement_changes.reason: The cited sections of Newey (1994) support the semiparametric variance lower bound used by the union-envelope theorem, but the supplied attestation does not support the stronger assertion that every limiting law has an independent-remainder convolution representation. Deleting that unused assertion narrows the claim to exactly the cited result.
